title: The Moral Foundations of Politics
partTitle: There's More to Morality than Harm and Fairness
frozenBasis: Official table of contents confirms chapter title and placement.
Official introduction supports the claim that morality contains several concerns rather than only harm and fairness.
Officially linked summary/outline supports the move from multiple moral foundations into political interpretation.
supportablePoints: Chapter 7 begins applying the broadened moral framework to political life.
The chapter likely argues that political disagreement often reflects different moral emphases rather than an absence of morality.
The chapter is diagnostic and interpretive before it becomes prescriptive.
The chapter builds on Chapter 6 and prepares the asymmetry claim in Chapter 8.
unsupportedZones: No overclaiming precise measurement claims or fixed numeric profiles beyond the narrow chapter frame.
No cartoon treatment of political camps as heroes or villains.
No importing Chapter 8's asymmetry as if Chapter 7 already proves it in full.
